c: Peter shifts from denunciation of false teachers to exhortation of believers. The false teachers’ skepticism about Christ’s return required clear teaching. Christians need to hold onto the apostolic message about the day of judgment and live godly lives in anticipation of that day.

Creation is the first evidence that the false teachers were wrong: Change does happen. If God made the world, he certainly can destroy it. •
